title: Records Harris played on with Domino, Tommy Ridgley and Bartholomew
summary: Harris lists records he made, including Detroit City, and discusses what Domino recorded.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: well you made a lot of hip records do you remember some of the records that you were on?

yeah I was one of the records that made him famous the Fat Man you were on that? I was on that record Detroit City and we had about seven or eight more records that we made that I was on I was on the record with this boy Toma Trisley we made this three times seven that was good and a deep track you see a Seussberry blues that was good and then we have a instrument recording we made High Society and I played the clarinet part on the alto oh yeah
it sounds good though Fat Domino
huh? Fat Domino I was with David Flamie at the same time
Fat Domino I think made a High Society too it seems like once I know I made a High Society with Dave
I don't think no I don't think Fat made a High Society
no no I was thinking of the Careless Love he made I knew there was some of the tunes they used down here he'd be recorded too I was trying to think about it
and then we had this Goetown Blues that's sold too that's a great time to do that
